purpose: A formatter-only turn, then a turn that moves a file and makes noise elsewhere.

windows.head: c1
windows.note: reformat only: two files modified in place, nothing moved

windows.head: c2
windows.note: a delayed move alongside a reformat of a different file

notes: Any pair asserted on the first window is fabricated out of whitespace: both files are modified in place and appear in no candidate set at all — which is itself the finding about candidate sets, not about similarity scores.
